goal.objective: Resolve whether the frozen common terminal acquisition-probe pilot warrants a main design confirmation or closes this allocation. Challenge source-supported treatment and observation assumptions against an independently fitted or bounded strong history/growth alternative and the closest experimental-design prior. Inspect actual summary outputs, independently quantify a material contrary or observation bound without raw access, and save a scoped independent recommendation, with the smallest discriminating next design only if earned.
